segments.sn11.21:1.2: Atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn11.21:1.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn11.21:2.1: “Kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati;
segments.sn11.21:3.1: “Kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ chetvā na socati;
segments.sn11.21:3.5: Vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañhi chetvā na socatī”ti.
